test_title: PYST 31: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 1 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

This cat and mouse game __are__ famous with all children in the future.
solution:
The correct answer is: **will be**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We know that when two singular nouns joined by "**AND**" denote the same person or thing, the pronoun used for them must be singular in number.
